messages:
zoe: Heads-up: Joint webinar with CloudSilo next Wednesday 11:00am PT. Were doing a short partner showcase + live integration demo. Planning notes below. Can the folks in ops/devex confirm availability for a 30m tech dry-run on Tuesday 3pm?

mike: I can do Tue 3pm. My checklist: demo infra, marketplace provisioning flow, and slide transition timing. Also need to verify OIDC consumer config with CloudSilo marketplace listing.

janet: I'll own swag logistics. Clarifying: 120 attendee bundles (stickers, one sticker sheet, 1 hoodie, 1 USB-C cable). Any custom customs paperwork for EU attendees? We have 40 EU RSVPs on the list.

oscar: Tech notes: CloudSilo demo will call our hosted endpoint, then failover to Dedicated in case of high latency. We need to test the routing policy that prefers regional hosts. Also confirm that their SSO redirect URI is added to our staging redirect allowlist.

zoe: Good call. Mike can you run a smoke on the OIDC flow and paste the exact redirect URI? We must add it before the dry-run.

mike: Redirect URI: https://integrations.cloudsilo.com/oauth/callback. Will add to staging allowlist now.

janet: For customs: shipping vendor flagged hoodies as textiles, value declared in manifesto is $22/kit. I'll get pro-forma invoices for the EU batch by EOD and upload to the shared drive. Link: https://drive.internal/marketing/webinar-swags (internal) :truck:

oscar: Network ports: partner demo profile needs outbound to our hosted API over 443, and a small websocket to logs.redwood.io over 443 as well. No special ports otherwise. Also request: if we can provide a small test token with limited scope for their demo that expires after the event.

zoe: Let's keep tokens limited. Mike, can you provision a short-lived demo token (expires in 6 hours) and post in backstage Slack DM at start of session?

mike: Done. Token created: demo-token-webinar-176912. Will DM to CloudSilo speaker at 10:55am day-of.

janet: Swag courier timeline: pick-up Tue evening, in-city delivery Wed 8:30am, on-site prep team will pack kits starting 9am. Need volunteer for final QA of kits at 9:30am. Who can do 9:30am on-site QA?

oscar: I can cover QA at 9:30am. Also I'll validate the demo fallback script during the dry-run.

zoe: Dry-run agenda (Tue 3pm, 30m):
- 3:00 start + intro (5m)
- 3:05 OIDC & token smoke (5m)
- 3:10 live call to hosted -> induce failover -> observe Dedicated fallback (10m)
- 3:20 slide handoffs & presenter mic test (5m)
- 3:25 final checklist & swag QA confirmation (5m)

mike: Quick command for failover smoke (use on staging):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference/api/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer demo-token-webinar-176912' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-hosted-alpha","prompt":"demo failover test","max_tokens":16,"simulate_load":true}'
```
Expect initial route to hosted, then a routed response from `redwood-dedicated-fallback` when simulate_load:true is set. Watch `routing-decisions` and `latency-metrics` streams.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run Tue 15:00 (1769211600). I will ping this channel 15m before. :bell:

janet: Drafted a short partner note for CloudSilo to include in attendee packages: "Thanks for joining the live hands-on. Visit our marketplace listing for a free trial and partner discount." I'll share printable label PDFs by tomorrow noon.

zoe: Perfect. Last ask: Can someone snapshot the marketplace listing (screenshots) after we enable the CloudSilo integration so marketing has images for the follow-up email?

mike: I'll take screenshots after integration goes live Tue morning and upload to the drive.

zoe: Great. If no blockers, we'll lock the runbook and proceed. Thanks all. :sparkles:
